system.description: Starting at 14th level, your Grim jutsu has become an extension of the Reapers insatiable will. Once per turn, when you cast a jutsu with the Grim prefix that deals damage as part of its casting, you regain hit points equal to half the damage dealt. If the effect would affect multiple creatures, you regain half the damage rolled.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
